tess (Marketing): Quick alignment before tomorrow's announcement. Need: final 2-line "what's new" for the tweet, docs landing URL, webinar CTA, benchmark highlight, and how inbound leads should be tagged in HubSpot. Can we lock by 3pm PT? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan (Eng): No API changes. Main infra note: canary will run 10% traffic for 30m then step to 50% if stable. I'll paste a one-line changelog.

ryan (Eng): `Changelog: v2.3.1 - 30% faster cold-start, safer canary routing, fixed KV cache edge-case.`

lina (Docs): I'll publish the release landing and migration notes by 4pm PT. Prod URL will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.3.1 — will confirm.

noah (Growth): Webinar confirmed Wed 11am PT. We'll add "live demo + Q&A". For HubSpot, add property "campaign=release-2-3-1" and route to SDR queue #1.

tess (Marketing): Nice. Can we get a single benchmark bullet for the press: what workload/seq length produced the 30%? Keep it short.

ryan (Eng): Benchmark note: 2k token seqs, gpt-like decoder workloads, median p95 token latency down ~30%.

Tess (Marketing): Perfect. Drafting announcement now. Will include webinar CTA, docs link, and a short paragraph on rollback policy.

sre-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2027-10-20T18:00:00Z -> 10% for 30m, then 50% for 20m if healthy. Alerting to #eng-oncall enabled.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: rolling canary start 2027-10-20T18:00:00Z. Auto-rollback on error rate >2%.

tess (Marketing): I'll post draft at 2:30pm PT for 30m review. Please react with :thumbsup: if no edits by 3pm and I'll send to the press list.

ryan (Eng): I'll be available during the window.

lina (Docs): Pinged with final prod link at 3:55pm PT: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.3.1 — updated migration AB notes.

noah (Growth): HubSpot tagging and SDR routing configured. Slack DM if we need manual triage.

tess (Marketing): Thanks all. Sending draft in 5. :rocket:
